name: manual_24b4fa
claim: When an open PR branch advances concurrently, do not create a catch-up merge or rebase by default: re-read the new head, reapply the verified delta directly on it, and move on; reserve merge integration for a real dependency or a later PR that must combine independent histories.

decisions.notes: PT PR #441, 2026-10-14: the branch advanced while a verified memory update was ready. The correct response is a fresh expected-head reapply, not a redundant merge commit that adds history without combining a required dependency. This keeps shared PR branches linear and reviewable until an actual cross-PR integration is needed.
